subject: Moving our call
text: Would it be alright to move Thursday’s planning call to early next week? The grant budget sheet is still unfinished, and I do not want to interrupt your afternoon with rough numbers. I can circulate the current draft tonight, then we could talk once the totals settle. If Tuesday or Wednesday before noon works, pick the slot that gives you the easiest day. I will send a fresh invite with the agenda, reading time, and the finance template. Thanks for your patience while this piece gets tightened. The committee still expects our recommendation by month-end, so I hope the delay will not create trouble. Please let me know.
